review_scope.CLI_limit: not present in initial scoped file listing; prospective gates below require code/captured evidence before final acceptance

checked_facts.fact: All supplied bytes require exact lowercase SHA, bounded immutable bytes; closed JSON rejects duplicate keys, floating/nonfinite values, invalid UTF8 and malformed structure with fixed messages; rubric/contract fixed SHA match original D118.

Schema bool/int distinction and five integer components0..20; six rubric critical types independently inventoried with bounded count, unique IDs and description/evidence hashes. A total100 never compensates for a critical incident or decides acceptance.

Declarations require explicit bool/null with no truthy coercion; all human/independence/blinding/custody/chronology/Q/acceptance/formal verification flags remain false. Output allowlist returns scores, hashes and typed counts; no original descriptions or IDs.

Opaque delivery content/redaction/semantic correctness and incident evidence are explicitly unverified. Incident deduplication/harmonization and confirmatory two-judge/arbitration rules are not invented for DEV.

prospective_CLI_gates.risk: Path alias or file replacement during private read can invalidate the claimed private single-link original snapshot. This is a design gate, not a reproduced finding in nonexistent CLI.
prospective_CLI_gates.requested_check: Reject symlink parents/terminal; validate fd and named regular-file identity dev/inode/uid/mode/nlink/size/mtime/ctime before and after bounded read, closing descriptor on every path. Include deterministic replacement/hardlink-added/read-race negatives.
prospective_CLI_gates.scope: cooperative same-UID custody; do not claim external authentication

prospective_CLI_gates.risk: Opening FIFO/device before validation may block or read inappropriate unbounded input despite a private-file precheck.
prospective_CLI_gates.requested_check: Use nofollow+nonblock open and fstat regular check before read; consume at mostcap+1; reject overrun/truncation/changes. Finite FIFO/directory/symlink/oversize and parent-policy tests.

prospective_CLI_gates.risk: Parser, OSError or traceback text can expose a private filename or supplied raw text on rejection.
prospective_CLI_gates.requested_check: CLI parser/error handlers must emit fixed allowlisted messages, not argv/path/raw exception text. Negative tests include private basename/content sentinels, malformed Unicode/JSON/digests and duplicate fields; bind fixed public-contract originals independently.
